findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, and used; test strips.
findings.comment: Observed there was not any sanitizer available for use while drinks were being served. The PIC setup the triple sink testing at 400 ppm (quat) during the inspection. Ensure that there is always a sanitizing solution available during all hours of operation.
findings.citation_text: 4-303.11(B) Cleaning Agents and Sanitizers, Availability. (B) Except for those that are generated on-site at the time of use, chemical SANITIZERS that are used to sanitize EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS as specified under Part 4-7, shall be provided and available for use during all hours of operation.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment:
Observed the following require cleaning:

(1) The accumulation of debris on the metal shelving in the kitchen by the entrance door (storing the microwave and other equipment/utensils).

(2) The accumulation of debris on the shelves inside of the cooler in the cooler/freezer storage room across from the kitchen entrance (storing various drinks). 

Non-food contact surfaces must be cleaned at a frequency necessary to avoid the accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. Ensure that the above referenced are cleaned to sight and touch by the next routine inspection.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(C) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment:
Observed the cove base has peeled off the wall in the following locations:

(1) Behind the bar hand washing sink.

(2) To the left of the cooler in the cooler/freezer storage room across from the entrance kitchen. 

Ensure that the cove base is sealed to the wall by the next routine inspection.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting
findings.comment:
Observed there was not signed employee health reporting forms at the facility. The PIC (person-in-charge) was given a blank copy during the inspection. All people who handle food at the establishment must sign the reporting forms. There will be a follow-up on 08/20/2024 to ensure that all food handling personal have signed the forms.

2-201.11: (A) The PERMIT HOLDER shall require FOOD EMPLOYEES and CONDITIONAL EMPLOYEES to report to the PERSON IN CHARGE information about their health and activities as they relate to diseases that are transmissible through FOOD. Report: Symptoms (all P except lesion), diagnosis (all P), and possible exposures (P).  (E) Responsibility of food employee to report symptoms/disease to PIC.

findings.title: Food separated and protected
findings.comment:
Observed the ice scoop at the bar (silver drawer ice storage bin) was stored with the handle in the ice. The ice scoop was moved into a position where the handle was not in contact with the ice during the inspection. Ensure that food is protected from cross contamination during storage.

3-302.11: (A) (1)-(2) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination during storage, preparation, holding, and display (P). (3) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination by cleaning visibly soiled containers, removing damaged containers, separating washed and unwashed produce (C).

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
Observed a cutting board being stored behind the triple sink faucet at the bar. Storing the cutting board in this position poses a risk of contamination from dirty water or soil residues while washing dishes. Ensure that food-contact surfaces are stored in a manner that avoids contamination. Also ensure that food-contact surfaces are cleaned when contamination occurs. The cutting board was removed from behind the triple sink during the inspection.

4-602.11: (A) FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES shall be cleaned before each use, each time there is a change in work, between uses of raw FOODS to RTE FOODS, before using FOOD TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICE, and when contamination has occurred. (C) Cleaned at least every 4 hours.

findings.title: Wiping cloths: properly used and stored
findings.comment:
This is a repeat violation from the 03/31/2023 inspection: Several wiping cloths were observed sitting on the countertops at the bar. Wiping cloths, once wet, must be stored in the sanitizer between uses or placed into laundry if no longer being used. Ensure that wiping cloths are stored properly between uses. 

3-304.14: (A) Cloths in-use for wiping FOOD spills for TABLEWARE and carryout containers shall be dry and used for no other purpose. (B) Cloths in-use for wiping counters and EQUIPMENT surfaces shall be held between uses in chemical sanitizer at proper solution and laundered daily. (C) Cloths in-use for wiping raw animal FOOD surfaces shall be separate from other cloths. (D) Dry wiping cloths and sanitizing solution shall be free of FOOD debris and other soil. (E) Containers of sanitizing solution shall be stored off floor and used in manner to prevent contamination. (F) SINGLE-USE disposable sanitizer wipes shall be used in accordance with EPA labels.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
Observed the dish drying racks in the kitchen have an accumulation of soil residue which poses a risk of re-contaminating clean dishes. Ensure that non-food contact surfaces are cleaned at a frequency necessary to avoid the accumulation of soil.

4-602.13: NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Observed the floor behind the stove top has an accumulation of trash, food debris, and soil residues. Physical facilities need to be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean.

6-501.12: (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.
